name: Peerspace landing page by peerspace.com
description: Peerspace's homepage alternates hard colour blocks — black hero, deep-violet awards banner, white category section, black filmstrip and city list, cream editorial breaks — each anchored by large credited photography like 'Production — Super8 studio, Houston TX'. Scale contrast carries the hierarchy: 100px+ grotesque headlines sit against 11px uppercase micro-labels and tiny state/country captions. Interaction is photo-led throughout: a floating three-field search card rides the hero, the activity tag cloud swaps the adjacent image, the dimmed grey city list brightens on hover, and carousels use thin arrows with 01/03 counters.
